interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted Codex CLI marketplace for ogg2mp3.
interface.longDescription: Provides a Codex CLI plugin (ogg2mp3) that converts QQ Music .ogg/.oggh files on macOS to .mp3 with embedded cover art (extracted from the macOS Resource Fork ICNS) and metadata. SKILL.md routes natural-language intent to the local ogg2mp3 binary (convert / batch / inspect / doctor).

plugins.name: ogg2mp3
plugins.description: Convert QQ Music .ogg/.oggh to .mp3 with embedded cover art and metadata. SKILL.md routes natural-language intent to the local ogg2mp3 binary (convert/batch/inspect/doctor).
